scene.ko: 단짝 친구와 다투고 점심을 혼자 먹는 외국인 학생의 고민을 듣고, 학생이 원하는 방식으로 도울 방법을 함께 찾는다.

lines.en: Leo, I noticed you've been eating lunch by yourself lately. Do you want to talk about it?
lines.ko: 레오, 요즘 점심을 혼자 먹는 것 같더라. 그 얘기 좀 해 볼래?
alt: Leo, I've seen you eating lunch alone recently. Would you like to talk about it?

lines.en: Not really... Well, Jaemin and I had a fight.
I'm sorry to hear that. You two were always together. What happened, if you don't mind me asking?
lines.ko: 그랬구나. 너희 둘은 늘 붙어 다녔잖아. 괜찮으면 무슨 일이 있었는지 말해 줄래?
alt: Oh, I'm sorry. You two were best friends. Can you tell me what happened, if that's okay?

lines.en: He made a joke about my Korean in front of everyone. Everyone laughed, and I just walked away.
lines.ko: 애들 다 있는 데서 제 한국어 가지고 농담을 했어요. 다들 웃었고, 저는 그냥 나와 버렸어요.

lines.en: That must have been really embarrassing. It makes sense that you felt hurt.
alt: That sounds really embarrassing. Of course you felt hurt.

lines.en: Now he won't talk to me. Maybe he thinks I'm angry, but I don't know what to say.
lines.ko: 그 뒤로 재민이가 저랑 말을 안 해요. 제가 화났다고 생각하는 것 같은데, 뭐라고 말해야 할지 모르겠어요.

lines.en: It sounds like you really miss him. Do you want to make up with him?
lines.ko: 재민이가 많이 보고 싶은가 보구나. 화해하고 싶어?
alt: Sounds like you miss your friend. Would you like to be friends again?

lines.en: Yes, but please don't tell him I said anything. I don't want things to get weird.
lines.ko: 네, 그런데 제가 말했다고는 하지 말아 주세요. 어색해지는 건 싫어요.

lines.en: I won't, I promise. How about I put you two in the same group for the science project? That might give you a chance to talk naturally.
lines.ko: 안 그럴게, 약속해. 과학 프로젝트 때 너희 둘을 같은 모둠에 넣어 주면 어떨까? 자연스럽게 이야기할 기회가 생길 수도 있잖아.
alt: I promise I won't. What if I put you both in the same group for the science project? You could talk more naturally that way.

lines.en: That's a good idea. Thanks for listening, Ms. Park.
lines.ko: 좋은 생각이에요. 얘기 들어 주셔서 감사해요, 선생님.

expressions.en: if you don't mind me asking
